source: SUN RGB-D support_train15; these scenes and relation labels were previously inspected for other work, so this is not a new held-out benchmark
matching: Use the previously saved Grounding DINO detections, match annotated child and parent at box IoU >=0.5, then compare visible mask adjacency to RGB-only pair labels. Report missing detections and uncertain labels separately.
claim_limits: The rule was devised after viewing the first 15-scene radial table sample. The second sample was itself previously viewed, so results are diagnostic transfer only. Mask adjacency is not physical contact and can miss occluded supports.
